| Gap | Tool | What it does | Limitation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cross-script numerical values** | `markomanninen/abnum3` | Gematria for Greek, Hebrew, Coptic, Aramaic, Syriac, Arabic, Phoenician, Brahmi. Additive and multiplicative. | Computes values; does not adjudicate intention. |
| **Gematria with final-letter conventions** | `KareyPyer/elizabethan-lispies` | Standard and extended final-letter values (ך=500, ם=600, etc.), notarikon, temurah, Atbash/Albam. | Common Lisp; not Python. |
